title: Codex reviewer delegation follow-up fails: thread/unarchive times out (500), and the identical replay is refused with 400 "no archived rollout found"
outcome: A follow-up sent to a completed read-only Codex reviewer delegation either resumes its archived thread or fails with a definite, recoverable answer. A timed-out unarchive never leaves the thread in a state where the identical replay is refused as missing.
acceptance: Codex reviewer delegation follow-up fails: thread/unarchive times out (500), and the identical replay is refused with 400 "no archived rollout found" is done
